meanings.translation: master (tradesman who is qualified to teach apprentices)
champion (someone who has been winner in a contest)
far, afar (long distance, physical or temporal)
sign (identifying a shop or other establishment)

unused_menu_senses.translation: peak (the top, or one of the tops, of a hill, mountain or range, ending in a point)

meanings.translation: honorary (given as an honor/honour, with no duties attached, and without payment)
honest (scrupulous with regard to telling the truth; not given to swindling, lying, or fraud)
subtitle, caption (textual versions of the dialog in films)
to end up (to arrive at a destination, sometimes unexpectedly)
to finish (to come to an end), to end (quick and abrupt; does not emphasize the process of ending, more abrupt than ukončit)
to use [with accusative ‘something’; or with genitive ‘’] (higher register with genitive)

canonical_example.translation: They all have one thing in common.
The old man opened the kitchen door.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to have (partake of a particular substance)

canonical_example.translation: The man choked her till she turned black.

meanings.translation: to insinuate (to hint at something; to suggest or express an idea indirectly)
